runtime.description: Canonical die definitions loaded by the online game. The die key is permanent; display names may change.

soulscimitar.flavor: A blade called through a circle that should have stayed closed.
soulscimitar.desc: Summons paired ghostly scimitars from the far edges of the battlefield. They choose targets independently, then grow into additional blades, life-steal, Slow, and piercing attacks as the die classes up.

slithervine.flavor: A patient root can become a wall. A hungry one grows teeth.
slithervine.desc: Targets the fastest enemy, breaking speed ties by current HP. Four destructible vine sections stitch across its route and force enemies to fight through them. Class growth hardens the barrier, adds barbs and control effects, and ultimately leaves surviving sections rooted between casts.

hga1.flavor: Two barrels, one rhythm, and a sky full of brass.
hga1.desc: A paired rapid-fire handgun die with independent magazines, Akimbo bursts, and a hold-activated Bullet Halo that locks regular fire, waits for both magazines to be full, then releases a radial barrage.

knightblade.flavor: A disciplined edge wins the fight before the flourish begins.
knightblade.desc: A front-target Physical combo die. It advances through Slash, Slash, and Cleave; only Cleave splashes nearby enemies. Class growth adds Double Slash, heavier Cleaves, execution damage, and Royal Cleave.

guardianshield.flavor: Stand behind it long enough and even bad luck learns to hesitate.
guardianshield.desc: A positional defensive die. Guard protects the Shield and nearby board spaces with damage reduction and a shimmering veil that lowers incoming status application chances. Higher Classes expand its formation and harden its protection.

wizardrod.flavor: The orb remembers every language the elements ever spoke.
wizardrod.desc: A random-target Special caster that begins with Arcane Bolt and learns elemental affinities by Class. At C5 its Bolts become AoE Siege waves; C6 and C7 introduce controlled Double and Triple Casts.

visual.summon: Rotating white alchemical sigil grows from small to roughly twice an average monster, sweeps crimson from the center outward, then restores white while the blade emerges.
visual.projectile: Off-white translucent ghost scimitar with a crimson demonic eye at the blade/hilt junction and a short crimson trail.
visual.impact: Blade appears to stab through its true target, dissolves into crimson particles, and the particles drift upward.

C1: Summon 2 blades, one from each far side.
C2: Increase damage through normal class damage scaling.
C4: True-target damage restores this die's HP by 25% of damage dealt; flash the casting die crimson.
C5: Each true-target hit has a 15% chance to Slow for 2 seconds.
C6: Blades pierce overlapping non-target enemies for 30% blade damage; pierced damage cannot heal and does not Slow.
C7: Increase damage through normal class damage scaling; summon 2 additional blades (6 total); pierced enemies have a 7% chance to Slow for 2 seconds.

visual.summon: Casting die and conjuring point glow green, followed by a small shockwave, dirt spray, and translucent green motes.
visual.travel: Three serpentine head vines repeatedly dive into and erupt from the ground while leaving four large continuous barrier sections behind them.
visual.impact: The three heads rear back, hesitate, then lance into the target. The heads remain extended for 1.2 seconds before dissolving; the body normally dissolves backward over 0.8 seconds.
visual.destruction: Broken sections splatter vine chunks, dirt, and green energy in the direction enemies are pushing through.

barrier.sectionBaseHp: one third of casting die max HP

C1: Basic skill: four destructible body sections and a three-head strike.
C3: Each section gains 10% HP and +3 percentage points damage reduction.
C4: Add yellow-green barbs that deal minor contact damage and slight knockback.
C5: Main strike gains 18% damage; barbs gain 35% damage; sections gain 5% HP and +2 percentage points damage reduction.
C6: Sections gain a faint yellow-green glow. Main hit has 20% Confusion chance; barb damage has 12% Silence chance; both last 2 seconds before Potency/resistance modifiers.
C7: Sections gain 12% HP and +2 percentage points damage reduction. Surviving body sections remain after the heads dissolve and are instantly dissolved when that same die casts again.

skills.name: Bullet Halo
skills.activation: hold deployed HG-A1; regular fire locks immediately and Halo waits until both magazines are full
skills.visual: Two side-view guns orbit in opposite directions while placing suspended radial bullets, brake, reverse their orbital spin, begin self-rotating, fade out completely, then release the Halo behind a yellow translucent shockwave with an orange outer ring.

C1: 10 rounds per handgun; 1.15s reload; Akimbo every fifth attack; Halo Stun 0.35s.
C3: 12 rounds per handgun; larger Halo; Stun becomes 0.50s.
C5: 14 rounds per handgun; larger Halo; Akimbo bullets deal 110% damage.
C7: 16 rounds per handgun; largest Halo; Halo bullets Launch on impact.

skills.name: Knight Blade
skills.visual: The long thin sword moves to the frontmost target. Slashes sweep immediately. Cleave rotates backward, holds the wound position for exactly 0.38 seconds, then cuts forward; only Cleave creates a gold AoE arc.

C1: Slash → Slash → Cleave. Cleave deals 150% primary damage and 50% ordinary-Slash splash.
C2: Cleave splash becomes 60% and its arc widens slightly.
C3: Ordinary Slashes have a 20% chance to immediately Double Slash without advancing the combo.
C6: Cleave gains +20% primary damage against targets below 30% max HP.
C7: Royal Cleave becomes 210% primary and 80% ordinary-Slash splash with a wider shockwave.

skills.name: Guard
skills.visual: When Guard activates, the registered shield art manifests on the Shield die and a mostly transparent blue aurora shimmers over every protected die.

C1: Every 6.5s Guard for 2.4s. Protect self plus four cardinal spaces: 18% damage reduction and 15% multiplicative status-chance reduction.
C4: Coverage expands to all eight adjacent spaces plus self.
C6: 2.9s duration; statuses that penetrate Guard have their added duration reduced by 20%.
C7: 3.0s Guard every 5.8s; 26% damage reduction, 35% status-chance reduction, and two extra distance-2 horizontal middle-line spaces.

pips.P7: Guard duration +0.15s and status-duration reduction +5 percentage points.

skills.name: Bolt / Siege
skills.visual: The rod fades in at center in front of the dice tray and charges energy around its orb. Arcane is black-blue; elemental casts assume the affinity color. It aims, hesitates, and fires capsule-shaped Bolts with fading sparks. C5 Siege has a longer hesitation and travels as a volatile elemental wave with small internal explosions; Siege is AoE.

C2: Learn Lightning, Fire, and Water Bolt.
C3: Learn Ice, Earth, and Metal Bolt.
C4: Learn Wind, Nature, Poison, Holy, and Shadow Bolt; all twelve affinities are now available.
C5: Bolts become Siege: 125% primary damage plus 45% ordinary-Bolt splash in a small AoE.
C6: Every fifth attack Double Casts two independently rolled spells.
C7: Every fifth attack Double Casts; every tenth attack Triple Casts instead.

pips.P3: Uses a shuffled element bag so learned elements do not repeat until the bag cycles.
pips.P7: Siege splash increases from 45% to 55% of ordinary Bolt damage.

skills.statusPolicy: Elemental affinity changes damage typing only; Wizard Rod does not add Burn, Freeze, Paralyze, Confusion, or other elemental status riders.
